meta.name: Go Go Gadget!: Inspector Gadget
meta.description:
Go Go Gadget! Join our bumbling detective, Inspector Gadget, along with Archie, Sonic, the Super Mario Brothers, and more on their funny and exciting adventures.

Shows: Inspector Gadget, Archie's Weird Mysteries, Archie's Weird Mysteries: Alternate Riverdales, Archie's Weird Mysteries: Teen Out of Time, Archie's Weird Mysteries: Invasion of the Cockroaches
Available on: Pluto TV
